name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
purpose: Open typed actions at a pointer or keyboard context request on a target region, with collision-safe viewport or contained-target positioning, semantic color, and configurable panel geometry.
accessibility: Pointer context requests open at their coordinates and clamp to the viewport or contained target.
ContextMenu and Shift+F10 open against the focusable target.
The shared menu engine provides roles, roving focus, typeahead, dismissal, and restoration.
commonMistakes: Making actions available only through context click.
Failing to label the target region.
